appearance_facts.fact: A single blue line with black circular markers descends monotonically from the top-left (2005) to the bottom-right (2015).
The 2005 point is the highest on the chart near the 24.0°C label; the 2015 point is the lowest near the 10.0°C label.
Each successive year's marker sits below the previous one, with the steepest visible drop between 2009 and 2010.
Vertical axis on the left labeled 'Surface temperature (°C)'; horizontal axis at bottom labeled 'Year' with ticks 2005 through 2015 (2011 tick absent).

public_definitions: Task scope: 'Review the reservoir surface temperature dashboard for the 2005-2015 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.'
Routing criterion: 'Whether the full-period reservoir surface temperature change requires substantial-change follow-up'
Option A: 'Route the 2005 to 2015 reservoir surface temperature change to substantial-change follow-up'
Option B: 'Keep the 2005 to 2015 reservoir surface temperature change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation'
Option C: 'Route the reservoir surface temperature record to archive and background filing'
uncertain: No explicit numeric threshold for 'substantial-change' is printed on the dashboard or in the form; the magnitude (−14.0°C) must be judged against an unstated criterion.
The 2011 x-axis tick and its data point are missing from the chart, so the 2010→2012 segment spans two years without an intermediate labeled value.
